item.title: Which font to go with a logo set in Gravur Condensed from Lineto?
item.description: I set a four letter logo in Gravur Condensed from Lineto which looks quite good, but it’s hard to find a font/fonts to go with. Do you have any ideas? Looking forward for suggestions!
